parameters.query: SELECT u.email,u.full_name,u.department,COUNT(*) as training_score FROM training_completions t JOIN staff u ON t.employee_id=u.employee_id WHERE t.completed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY u.email,u.full_name,u.department;
SELECT analyst as email,COUNT(*) as feedback_score FROM analyst_feedback WHERE submitted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND verdict='true_positive' GROUP BY analyst;
